description: Lane A tier subsets — token NAME lists consumed by tier-emitter.mjs. Names are dotted source names from the merged canon+supplement map. mobileCritical = minimal critical-path set for the PWA tier (99% of users). embedded = Node Zero subset (~4 colors / ~2 type sizes / ~3 spacings / ~2 radii — runbook A-4). Tiers are SUBSETS of the one source, never forks (Seven Laws #3).

mobileCritical.description: Minimal critical path: semantic colors, fluid type + spacing, radii, breakpoints, motion. Everything a 320px PWA needs to render and adapt.

embedded.description: Node Zero subset — runbook A-4 budget shape: ~4 colors, ~2 type sizes, ~3 spacings, ~2 radii. Gz budget < 2048 bytes (gate d).
